# Capability Router / 能力路由

> L0 boundary: this file guides decisions but does not hide, disable, install, or configure client capabilities.
> L0 边界：本文件只引导决策，不会隐藏、禁用、安装或配置客户端能力。

## Level 1

| Task type | Boundary | Candidates |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Direct answer / 直接作答 | Given information is enough; do not call extra tools / 信息足够时不调用额外工具 | no-extra-tool |
| Local files / 本地文件 | Read the user-scoped workspace; no deletion or configuration change / 只读指定范围，不删除、不改配置 | no-extra-tool |
| Public research / 公开调研 | Use public sources only; never use logged-in or private data / 只查公开来源，不碰登录态和私有数据 | public-doc-checker |
| Documents / 文档交付 | Use only for requested Word, PDF, slides, or sheets / 仅用于明确要求的办公文档 | no-extra-tool |
| Media / 媒体处理 | Use only authorized media; preserve source and license evidence / 仅处理授权素材并保留来源证据 | no-extra-tool |
| Browser control / 浏览器控制 | Explicitly requested UI work only; logged-in actions need approval / 仅明确要求的界面操作，登录态动作需批准 | no-extra-tool |
| GitHub / GitHub 操作 | Read first; publishing, PRs, issues, and releases need approval / 先只读，发布、PR、Issue、Release 需批准 | no-extra-tool |
| Build and code / 构建与代码 | Work inside the requested repository and verify outputs / 只改目标仓库并验证产物 | no-extra-tool |
| Governance / 系统治理 | Record proposals first; install, enable, disable, hooks, and config need approval / 先记录提案，安装启停和配置需批准 | session-manager |

## Level 2 Registry

| ID | Management / Health | Invocation | Authorization | Risk | Card |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| public-doc-checker | active / healthy | conditional | routing-proposal | low | [public-doc-checker.md](../capabilities/records/public-doc-checker.md) |
| session-manager | disabled / unverified | disabled | routing-proposal | high | [session-manager.md](../capabilities/records/session-manager.md) |

If nothing matches, use `no-extra-tool`; never scan the whole capability directory.
未命中时使用 `no-extra-tool`，不要扫描整个能力目录。
